content:
API: Swagger Petstore
Version: 1.0.7
Description: This is a sample server Petstore server.  You can find out more about Swagger at [http://swagger.io](http://swagger.io) or on [irc.freenode.net, #swagger](http://swagger.io/irc/).  For this sample, you can use the api key `special-key` to test the authorization filters.
Base path: /v2
Host: petstore.swagger.io

Endpoint: /pet/{petId}/uploadImage
  Method: POST
  Summary: uploads an image
  Description:
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - petId (path, integer, required=True)
    - additionalMetadata (formData, string, required=False)
    - file (formData, file, required=False)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation

Endpoint: /pet
  Method: POST
  Summary: Add a new pet to the store
  Description:
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - body (body, , required=True)
  Responses:
    - 405: Invalid input
  Method: PUT
  Summary: Update an existing pet
  Description:
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - body (body, , required=True)
  Responses:
    - 400: Invalid ID supplied
    - 404: Pet not found
    - 405: Validation exception

Endpoint: /pet/findByStatus
  Method: GET
  Summary: Finds Pets by status
  Description: Multiple status values can be provided with comma separated strings
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - status (query, array, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid status value

Endpoint: /pet/findByTags
  Method: GET
  Summary: Finds Pets by tags
  Description: Multiple tags can be provided with comma separated strings. Use tag1, tag2, tag3 for testing.
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - tags (query, array, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid tag value

Endpoint: /pet/{petId}
  Method: GET
  Summary: Find pet by ID
  Description: Returns a single pet
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - petId (path, integer, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid ID supplied
    - 404: Pet not found
  Method: POST
  Summary: Updates a pet in the store with form data
  Description:
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - petId (path, integer, required=True)
    - name (formData, string, required=False)
    - status (formData, string, required=False)
  Responses:
    - 405: Invalid input
  Method: DELETE
  Summary: Deletes a pet
  Description:
  Tags: pet
  Parameters:
    - api_key (header, string, required=False)
    - petId (path, integer, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 400: Invalid ID supplied
    - 404: Pet not found

Endpoint: /store/inventory
  Method: GET
  Summary: Returns pet inventories by status
  Description: Returns a map of status codes to quantities
  Tags: store
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation

Endpoint: /store/order
  Method: POST
  Summary: Place an order for a pet
  Description:
  Tags: store
  Parameters:
    - body (body, , required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid Order

Endpoint: /store/order/{orderId}
  Method: GET
  Summary: Find purchase order by ID
  Description: For valid response try integer IDs with value >= 1 and <= 10. Other values will generated exceptions
  Tags: store
  Parameters:
    - orderId (path, integer, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid ID supplied
    - 404: Order not found
  Method: DELETE
  Summary: Delete purchase order by ID
  Description: For valid response try integer IDs with positive integer value. Negative or non-integer values will generate API errors
  Tags: store
  Parameters:
    - orderId (path, integer, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 400: Invalid ID supplied
    - 404: Order not found

Endpoint: /user/createWithList
  Method: POST
  Summary: Creates list of users with given input array
  Description:
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - body (body, array, required=True)
  Responses:
    - default: successful operation

Endpoint: /user/{username}
  Method: GET
  Summary: Get user by user name
  Description:
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - username (path, string, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid username supplied
    - 404: User not found
  Method: PUT
  Summary: Updated user
  Description: This can only be done by the logged in user.
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - username (path, string, required=True)
    - body (body, , required=True)
  Responses:
    - 400: Invalid user supplied
    - 404: User not found
  Method: DELETE
  Summary: Delete user
  Description: This can only be done by the logged in user.
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - username (path, string, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 400: Invalid username supplied
    - 404: User not found

Endpoint: /user/login
  Method: GET
  Summary: Logs user into the system
  Description:
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - username (query, string, required=True)
    - password (query, string, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: successful operation
    - 400: Invalid username/password supplied

Endpoint: /user/logout
  Method: GET
  Summary: Logs out current logged in user session
  Description:
  Tags: user
  Responses:
    - default: successful operation

Endpoint: /user/createWithArray
  Method: POST
  Summary: Creates list of users with given input array
  Description:
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - body (body, array, required=True)
  Responses:
    - default: successful operation

Endpoint: /user
  Method: POST
  Summary: Create user
  Description: This can only be done by the logged in user.
  Tags: user
  Parameters:
    - body (body, , required=True)
  Responses:
    - default: successful operation

Schema: ApiResponse
Description:
  - code (integer):
  - type (string):
  - message (string):

Schema: Category
Description:
  - id (integer):
  - name (string):

Schema: Pet
Description:
  - id (integer):
  - category ():
  - name (string):
  - photoUrls (array):
  - tags (array):
  - status (string): pet status in the store

Schema: Tag
Description:
  - id (integer):
  - name (string):

Schema: Order
Description:
  - id (integer):
  - petId (integer):
  - quantity (integer):
  - shipDate (string):
  - status (string): Order Status
  - complete (boolean):

Schema: User
Description:
  - id (integer):
  - username (string):
  - firstName (string):
  - lastName (string):
  - email (string):
  - password (string):
  - phone (string):
  - userStatus (integer): User Status
